title: The Nehru era: more on planning, foreign policy, secularism

boxes.title: Nehru & planning: added detail
items: Died in his ==**fourth term**== (interim govt + **1952, 1957, 1962** elections); not Rae Bareli
Other books: **An Autobiography**, **Letters from a Father to His Daughter**
Planning Commission: on **Planning Advisory Board** advice; linked to **Art. 39** (DPSP); neither constitutional nor statutory
NDC: Union Cabinet Ministers + all **CMs** + UT representatives + Planning Commission members

boxes.title: Institutions, secularism, now
items: **CSIR**: **1942**; labs grew under Nehru. **UGC Act, 1956** (LENS Apr 2026)
Indian secularism: State neutral but may **reform social practices**; vs Western **strict separation**
**Art. 325**: no religious exclusion from electoral rolls
Ambedkar: **Labour Member**, Viceroy's Executive Council (**1942-46**); Hindu Code Bill introduced **1947** (inheritance, marriage, divorce, adoption)
**ICWA**: **25 years** as Institution of National Importance; hosted ==**Asian Relations Conference (1947)**==
